hero.titleLine2: Vertically integrated, privately deployable end to end
hero.lede: Lex is the legal-technology product line of FindData: statute and case data, contract-intelligence apps, in-house legal models and the execution base, delivered as one versioned distribution package — one capability set across two hosts, our cloud or your machine room.

capabilities.title: Capability catalog
capabilities.lede: Lex capabilities are produced by a single builder and delivered in one versioned distribution package, hosted in our cloud or in your machine room. Every entry's availability per host is stated honestly; no unstated host differences exist beyond this catalog.

retrieval.name: Legal data search
retrieval.desc: Legal search service for agents and business systems, with source citations attached to results.
points: Statute semantic search
Similar-case search
Guiding-case search
Article-level citation parsing
Five-source corpus (provided with the corpus pack)

contract.name: Contract intelligence
contract.desc: The legal contract workbench: drafting and review.
points: Contract drafting and generation
Contract review
52 domain tools

esignature.name: Contract e-signature
esignature.desc: One chain from review to evidence: anchor the finalized version by hash, send signing links, and seal only after identity and signing-intent verification.
points: Review, final draft, signing and evidence in one flow
Identity and signing-intent verification via a licensed provider
Hash-anchored final version; contract text never leaves your side
Applicability gate for documents excluded by law
Certificate chain, trusted timestamp and audit trail — tamper-evident
esignature.note: In preview: the signing leg is being integrated with a licensed e-signature provider; cloud and on-prem signing open after sandbox validation. Article 14 of the PRC E-Signature Law: a reliable electronic signature has the same legal effect as a handwritten signature or seal.

models.name: In-house legal models
models.desc: In-house fine-tuned models on two legs: review and drafting.
points: Judge (judge_c) · review
Drafter (drafter_a) · drafting
Quantized artifacts and paired evaluation reports ship with the package
models.note: Cloud GPU inference and model API: not provided in v1 (planned for v1.x)

distribution.name: Private distribution package
distribution.desc: Versioned full-stack delivery: installation, upgrades, three data tiers and incremental updates.
points: Citation pack: statute library + statute catalog + guiding cases (required base)
Corpus pack: adds the five-source corpus and contract templates (optional)
Judgment pack: full judgments, approx. 175 GB, customized after per-project legal review
Incremental updates: daily / weekly pulls + offline full-package fallback

api.name: API / MCP access
api.desc: One credential for legal search and legal data tools.
points: MCP protocol endpoint
Legal data tool set
Dual-unit metering: per row / per call

capabilities.footnote: Capability differences between the two hosts are limited to what this catalog annotates; cloud and on-premises are produced by the same builder.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.lede: Lex is billed by plan. Plan numbers are configured in the admin backend, never pre-filled or publicly listed; they are fixed when the contract is signed.
pricing.subtitle: Billing dimensions

units.name: Metering units
units.value: Reads / searches per row; generations / evaluations per call

pricing.note: When quota runs out the service pauses automatically; quota status and recovery paths are visible in the console. Pricing dimensions are fixed at signing.
pricing.contactPending: Business contact channel being set up

docs.title: Private deployment
docs.lede: The full Lex stack is privately deployable: one versioned distribution package, produced by a single builder, running independently in your machine room.

deploy.name: Deployment
deploy.desc: One-click install via single-machine container orchestration; the bundle is versioned and component images are digest-locked; installation is verified by the bundled smoke checks.

airgap.name: Air-gapped environments
airgap.desc: After installing from the media alone, with no internet connection, the core capabilities — statute search, similar-case search and contract drafting — remain available.

upgrade.name: Upgrades
upgrade.desc: Upgrades are reinstall-based; customer data volumes — corpora, generated artifacts and configuration — are fully preserved.

updates.name: Incremental updates
updates.desc: A customer-side scheduled task pulls daily / weekly increment packages from the distribution endpoint (credential-authenticated); each package passes an integrity check, and a failed check means it is never applied.

offline.name: Offline channel
offline.desc: Customers who cannot reach the endpoint receive equivalent incremental content through the offline full-package channel.

tiers.name: Three data tiers
tiers.desc: The citation pack (statute library + statute catalog + guiding cases) is the required base; the corpus and judgment packs are optional; the judgment pack (full judgment texts) is excluded by default and customized only after per-project legal review.

docs.note: Hardware requirements and the full delivery documentation ship with the distribution package (placeholder here; no commitments beyond the settled scope).

docHub.indexLede: Integration guides and manuals, served in the current language; the Chinese and English versions are maintained in parity.

notFound.title: Document not found
notFound.lede: This document does not exist or has not been published yet; pick another one from the docs index.

console.title: Lex Console
console.credentialProxyNote: Keys are minted/revoked through the lex API proxy to the registry. The plaintext appears once in the mint response; the platform never stores it and cannot recover it.

error.title: Request failed
error.authHint: Sign in again; if this is an organization issue, ask the platform team to grant lex-customers membership.

gate.blockedBody: Logto sign-in is not configured on the server (missing environment variables); the console stays disabled rather than faking a login. Missing:
gate.blockedConfigHint: A Logto SPA application must be created and LOGTO_ISSUER / LOGTO_CLIENT_ID filled in (see the deployment runbook).
gate.loginTitle: Sign in to the Lex console
gate.loginBody: Sign in or register with your enterprise account. External customers belong to the lex-customers organization, isolated from internal identities.
gate.loginUnavailable: Sign-in service is unavailable right now; please retry later.
gate.loginHint: Sign-in and registration happen on the Logto-hosted page. Keys and usage are then self-served under that identity.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Customer profile, current-period usage and quota state at a glance.
overview.unboundHint: This identity is not yet bound to a billing customer. Usage is still counted under your identity; billing and quota appear once operations bind it in the admin console.

credentials.title: API keys
credentials.subtitle: Mint and revoke long-lived keys for MCP access (no auto-expiry; revocation is immediate).
credentials.mintHint: The plaintext is shown once right after minting; save it immediately.
credentials.plaintextHint: It cannot be viewed again after closing or refreshing; only the hash is stored. Keep it in your secret manager.
credentials.revokeConfirm: Revoke key "{{name}}"? Revocation is irreversible and the next call is rejected.
credentials.eventsHint: Only mint/revoke events performed through this console (metadata; no plaintext, no hash).

usagePage.title: Usage
usagePage.subtitle: Calls and dual-unit quantities for this customer (including bound identities) in the selected period; same basis as metering records.
usagePage.empty: No usage recorded in this period.

billing.title: Billing
billing.subtitle: The lex ledger is authoritative; the payment-side balance is only the execution channel.
billing.unboundHint: This identity is not bound to a billing customer, so billing is not visible yet. Ask operations to bind it in the admin console.
billing.totalHint: Sum of micro-amounts over returned ledger entries
billing.noEntries: No ledger entries in this period.
billing.ledgerNote: Settlement runs per period; overage uses the plan unit price and price changes take effect immediately.

quota.title: Quota state
quota.subtitle: Per-unit water level and hard-stop verdict (fail-closed); usage comes from the live metering stream.
quota.unboundHint: Once bound, per-unit quota levels and recovery paths appear here.

recovery.upgrade: Quota exhausted: contact sales to upgrade the plan or add quota; included quota resets on the 1st of next month.
recovery.topUp: Insufficient balance: top up the payment account and access resumes automatically.
recovery.unreachable: Billing plane unreachable: calls are denied fail-closed and resume automatically once it recovers; escalate if it persists.
recovery.contact: Need help? Contact sales or platform operations.
recovery.notProvisioned: Not provisioned yet: contact sales to get started.

gate.title: Operations admin sign-in
gate.noCredentials: No usable credentials detected: sign in with a Logto identity holding an admin role, or enter the internal token.
gate.roleHint: The current console identity is not an admin; a role from ADMIN_ROLES can be assigned in Logto instead.
gate.hint: The token is stored in this browser's localStorage and is for internal operations only; when the server has no token configured every request is refused (fail-closed).

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Provision customers (sub2api creates the payment account) / change plan and status / bind Logto identities.
customers.sub2apiNote: Provisioning calls sub2api (idempotent); failures surface honestly and leave no local dirty row.
customers.noPlans: Create a plan first under Plans
customers.identitiesHint: Bind the customer's Logto identity (username/email) to this customer; the console resolves usage and billing through it.

plans.title: Plans
plans.subtitle: Tiers, included quota and overage unit prices; saving takes effect immediately, no release needed.
plans.noDeployNote: Saving takes effect immediately (settlement reads current prices)
plans.savedNotice: Saved; the new price applies to subsequent metering immediately.
plans.empty: No plans yet (numbers are never pre-filled; configure on demand).

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.subtitle: Read-only billing_ledger_entries; amounts are booked in micro-units and displayed in CNY.
ledger.empty: No ledger entries under the current filter.
ledger.footnote: The idempotency key is unique; replaying the same key never double-books (settlement idempotency guard).

usage.title: Usage overview
usage.subtitle: metering_records aggregated by (track × caller × unit); the platform track is not billed.
usage.empty: No metering records in this period.
usage.footnote: The usage stamp is the sole billing basis; audit events missing a usage stamp land in the anomaly table (never silent).

credentials.title: Key audit
credentials.subtitle: Mint/revoke events performed through the lex console proxy (metadata; neither plaintext nor hash is stored).

deploy.title: Lex on-premise delivery
deploy.lede: A versioned delivery bundle from the same builder runs standalone in the customer's data centre: single-machine container orchestration, digest-pinned component images, three data tiers on demand. Cloud and on-premise share one capability set, with differences limited to what the capability catalog states.

single.name: Single bundle install
single.desc: Installed from the shipped media: the citation bundle is the mandatory base, corpus and judgment bundles are optional per project scope.

incremental.name: Incremental channel
incremental.desc: Customer-side scheduled tasks pull daily/weekly increments from the distribution endpoint (credential-authenticated); integrity checks gate every apply.

airgap.name: Offline channel
airgap.desc: For environments with media only and no internet, the offline full bundle carries the same incremental content as the online channel.

scope.cloud: Cloud: lex.finddatatech.cloud serves retrieval, contract intelligence and model API access (model API planned for v1.x).
scope.private: On-premise: one-command single-machine compose; statute and case retrieval plus contract generation work in an isolated (no-internet) environment.
scope.contract: Acceptance: a smoke checklist ships with the bundle plus versioned rollback; upgrades are reinstall-style and preserve customer data volumes.
